auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Run your Instagram operations from one place.

workspaces.none: You do not have a workspace yet.

banner.simulationDetail: This workspace is simulated; nothing is sent to real Instagram.

empty.comingLater: This section arrives in a later phase
empty.comingLaterHint: For now the basic structure of your workspace is in place.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Choose the interface language. Your choice is saved to your account.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.body: The page or workspace you are looking for was not found.

INVALID_CREDENTIALS.next: Check your details and try again.

CSRF_FAILED.next: Reload the page and try again.

FORBIDDEN.next: Ask the workspace owner for help.

NOT_FOUND.what: We could not find what you were looking for.
NOT_FOUND.next: Check the address or go back to the home page.

CONFLICT_STATE.what: This action is not possible in the current state.
CONFLICT_STATE.next: Reload the page and try again.

INTERNAL_ERROR.next: Try again. If it keeps happening, share the request ID.

NETWORK_ERROR.what: The server could not be reached.
NETWORK_ERROR.next: Check your connection and try again.

VERSION_CONFLICT.what: Someone changed this while you were working.
VERSION_CONFLICT.next: Reload the page and try again.

FACT_VERSION_CONFLICT.what: This information was changed by someone else while you were editing.
FACT_VERSION_CONFLICT.next: Reload to see the latest value, then edit again.

APPROVAL_ALREADY_DECIDED.what: A decision was already made on this approval.
APPROVAL_ALREADY_DECIDED.next: Reload the page to see the current state.

APPROVAL_STALE.what: What you were about to approve has changed.
APPROVAL_STALE.next: Review the current summary and decide again.

FACT_NOT_USABLE.what: This information is not verified yet, so it cannot be used.
FACT_NOT_USABLE.next: Verify it first under Business information.

FACT_CHANGED_MEANWHILE.what: The information was changed by someone else while you were confirming, so it was not updated.
FACT_CHANGED_MEANWHILE.next: Check the current value and give the command again.

LLM_UNAVAILABLE.what: The AI service is not reachable right now.
LLM_UNAVAILABLE.next: Try again in a moment, or enter the information manually.

LLM_OUTPUT_INVALID.what: I could not understand that command.
LLM_OUTPUT_INVALID.next: Try a simpler sentence, or enter the information manually.

LLM_REFUSED.what: The AI did not answer this request.
LLM_REFUSED.next: Rephrase it, or do it manually.

LLM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.what: Today's AI usage limit has been reached.
LLM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.next: Try again tomorrow, or do it manually.

MESSAGING_WINDOW_CLOSED.what: Instagram only allows a reply within 24 hours of the customer's last message, and that time is over.
MESSAGING_WINDOW_CLOSED.next: Wait for the customer to write again, or contact them another way.

ACCOUNT_NOT_CONNECTED.what: The Instagram account is not connected right now.
ACCOUNT_NOT_CONNECTED.next: Connect the account again under Automation, then try once more.

MEDIA_INVALID.what: This file is not a supported image.
MEDIA_INVALID.next: Upload a JPEG or PNG image.

MEDIA_TOO_LARGE.what: This image file is too large.
MEDIA_TOO_LARGE.next: Choose a smaller image (the default limit is 8 MB).

CONTENT_VALIDATION_FAILED.what: This content cannot be submitted yet.
CONTENT_VALIDATION_FAILED.next: Fix the listed items, then submit again.

MEDIA_REJECTED.what: Instagram could not process the image.
MEDIA_REJECTED.next: Replace it with another image and schedule the post again.

PUBLISH_DEADLINE_PASSED.what: The post could not be published in time.
PUBLISH_DEADLINE_PASSED.next: Choose a new time and schedule it again.

PUBLISH_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.what: The daily publishing limit has been reached.
PUBLISH_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.next: It will be tried again automatically later.

PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.what: Instagram is not reachable right now.

PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED.what: Instagram asked us to slow down.

PROVIDER_REJECTED.next: Review the post and schedule it again.

CAPABILITY_MISSING.what: Permission for this action was not granted.
CAPABILITY_MISSING.next: Reconnect the account and allow it.

ACCOUNT_NEEDS_REAUTH.what: The Instagram connection must be renewed.

OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.what: We are still checking whether it was published.
OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.next: Wait a moment. Do not post it again by hand yet.

OUTCOME_UNCONFIRMED.what: We could not confirm whether it was published.
OUTCOME_UNCONFIRMED.next: Check Instagram before posting it again.

REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND.what: I could not find the post you mean.
REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND.next: Give its date or title, or pick it in Content.

PLACEHOLDER_INVALID.what: A fact placeholder in the text could not be filled in.
PLACEHOLDER_INVALID.next: Write the text yourself, or verify the fact in Business information.

CONTENT_CHANGED.what: You changed the draft while it was being prepared, so no automatic text was added.
